_comment: Intro dialogue for Mission Ares 1. 'speaker' is 'aria' (the base AI) or a role id from roles.json. Optional 'event' runs when the line starts: alarm_on, alarm_off, shake, lights_dim. In 'farewell', {player} = chosen crew name, {player_role} = chosen role title. Lines with speaker 'player' are said by the chosen astronaut; 'sleeper' lines are said by each sleeping crew member (one random line each).

intro.speaker: aria
intro.text: WARNING! A massive dust storm is approaching Ares Base. Estimated arrival: 2 hours.

intro.speaker: aria
intro.text: Based on current projections, approximately 75% of our solar panel array will be damaged or rendered inoperable.

intro.speaker: engineer
intro.text: That's a critical loss. Our solar array powers life support, heating, water recycling, and laboratory systems.

intro.speaker: astrophysicist
intro.text: Global dust storms can engulf the entire planet. The 2018 storm blocked sunlight from reaching NASA's Opportunity rover, eventually ending its mission.

intro.speaker: medic
intro.text: A.R.I.A., how many crew members can the remaining solar capacity sustain?

intro.speaker: aria
intro.text: Calculating... Current projections indicate that the remaining 25% of our solar array can sustain only one crew member.

intro.speaker: biologist
intro.text: Then we need to reduce our life-support demand immediately. We can't risk losing the entire crew.

intro.speaker: engineer
intro.text: The cryogenic pods! Placing three crew members in cryosleep would significantly reduce our power and life-support requirements.

intro.speaker: medic
intro.text: The pods can keep them stable, but someone must remain conscious to maintain the base and monitor their vital systems.

intro.speaker: aria
intro.text: Confirmed. With three crew members in cryosleep, available reserves are projected to sustain the remaining crew member for up to 60 sols, provided energy consumption is carefully managed.

intro.speaker: astrophysicist
intro.text: It's our only viable option. Three of us enter cryosleep. One remains on duty.

intro.speaker: biologist
intro.text: Then we need someone capable of keeping the mission alive. Who will stay?

intro.speaker: aria
intro.text: Commander, a decision is required. Select the crew member who will remain awake and assume responsibility for Ares Base.

farewell.speaker: player
farewell.text: I'll stay. As the {player_role}, I'll do everything I can to keep this base running and complete our mission.

farewell.speaker: aria
farewell.text: Initiating cryosleep sequence. Remaining crew, please enter your pods.

sleeper_lines: We trust you, {player}. We'll be waiting when you wake us up!
Keep an eye on the power supply. Every bit of energy counts!
Don't forget to take care of yourself while we're asleep.
We'll see you when the storm is over, {player}. Good luck!

ending.speaker: aria
ending.text: Cryosleep sequence complete. Three crew members are now safely asleep.

ending.speaker: aria
ending.text: {player}, you are the only crew member awake. Ares Base is now under your care. Good luck, Commander.
